name: incidentiq
description: IncidentIQ — AI-assisted IT incident triage and SLA management

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev:api: wait-on tcp:8000 && npm --prefix backend run db:create-table && npm --prefix backend start
scripts.dev:web: wait-on tcp:3001 && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
